What if the later ticket was accepted and then a configure happened (resetting latest_seq)? Then the later ticket's acceptance is "historical". My implementation resets latest_seq on configure, so the check would say "not superseded". But the ticket being delivered would be obsolete anyway (different generation) since a configure bumps g... unless the delivered ticket was issued AFTER the configure while the accepted later ticket was issued BEFORE the configure — impossible, since a ticket issued after the configure has a higher seq than any pre-configure ticket, and pre-configure acceptances have lower seqs. So latest_seq (reset) < the new ticket's seq → not superseded ✓. And a pre-configure ticket being delivered after the configure → obsolete ✓ (rule 2). So the reset doesn't cause discrepancies ✓.

import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
from protocol import validate
from te.session import run_case
import verify as V

edges=[[0,1,5],[1,2,5],[0,2,3]]
coms=[{"source":0,"sink":2,"demand":6,"paths":[[0,1],[2]]}]
def mk(events, mode="admit", quorum=1, max_lag=0, workers=[[0]]):
    return {"nodes":3,"edges":edges,"commodities":coms,"workers":workers,
            "quorum":quorum,"max_lag":max_lag,"relax":[1,1],"rho":1,"mode":mode,"events":events}

tests = {
 "save-restore-noop": mk([{"op":"issue","id":1,"worker":0},{"op":"deliver","id":1},
                          {"op":"save","name":1},{"op":"restore","name":1},{"op":"audit"},{"op":"step"}]),
 "triple-deliver": mk([{"op":"issue","id":1,"worker":0},{"op":"deliver","id":1},
                       {"op":"deliver","id":1},{"op":"deliver","id":1},{"op":"audit"}]),
 "retune-same": mk([{"op":"issue","id":1,"worker":0},{"op":"deliver","id":1},{"op":"step"},
                    {"op":"retune","rho":1},{"op":"retune","rho":1},{"op":"audit"},{"op":"step"}]),
 "maxlag0": mk([{"op":"issue","id":1,"worker":0},{"op":"deliver","id":1},{"op":"step"},
                {"op":"step"},{"op":"issue","id":2,"worker":0},{"op":"deliver","id":2},{"op":"step"},{"op":"audit"}]),
 "empty-worker": mk([{"op":"issue","id":1,"worker":1},{"op":"deliver","id":1},{"op":"step"},{"op":"audit"}],
                    workers=[[],[0]], quorum=2),
 "restore-then-old-ticket": mk([{"op":"issue","id":1,"worker":0},{"op":"save","name":1},
                                {"op":"deliver","id":1},{"op":"step"},{"op":"restore","name":1},
                                {"op":"deliver","id":1},{"op":"issue","id":2,"worker":0},
                                {"op":"deliver","id":2},{"op":"step"},{"op":"audit"}]),
 "configure-empty": mk([{"op":"issue","id":1,"worker":0},{"op":"deliver","id":1},{"op":"step"},
                        {"op":"configure","mode":"route","capacity":[],"demand":[],"paths":[]},
                        {"op":"audit"},{"op":"step"},{"op":"issue","id":3,"worker":0},
                        {"op":"deliver","id":3},{"op":"step"},{"op":"audit"}]),
 "many-restores": mk([{"op":"issue","id":1,"worker":0},{"op":"deliver","id":1},{"op":"save","name":1},
                      {"op":"step"},{"op":"restore","name":1},{"op":"restore","name":1},
                      {"op":"issue","id":2,"worker":0},{"op":"deliver","id":2},{"op":"step"},
                      {"op":"restore","name":1},{"op":"audit"},{"op":"step"}]),
 "mode-switch": mk([{"op":"issue","id":1,"worker":0},{"op":"deliver","id":1},
                    {"op":"configure","mode":"route","capacity":[],"demand":[[0,3]],"paths":[]},
                    {"op":"issue","id":2,"worker":0},{"op":"deliver","id":2},{"op":"step"},{"op":"audit"}]),
}
allok=True
for name,case in tests.items():
    req={"cases":[case]}; validate(req)
    resp={"cases":[run_case(case)]}
    errs=V.verify(req,resp)
    status="ok" if not errs else errs[0]["errors"][:3]
    print("%-24s %s"%(name,status))
    if errs: allok=False
print("ALL OK" if allok else "FAILURES")
EOF
